# REST API: Package indexes

These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `POST /api/v1/package-indexes`

Register a package index

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Registers an index that projects may install packages from, by name and URL, optionally with a credential secret. Only a registered URL is accepted. Needs `MANAGE_PACKAGE_INDEX` on the instance. Answers 409 when the name or URL is taken and 422 for a name, URL or secret name that is not valid.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `PackageIndexCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `url` | text | yes |  |
| `credential_secret` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `PackageIndexOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `PackageIndexOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `url` | text | yes |  |
| `credential_secret` | text or null | yes |  |
| `created_by` | text (uuid) or null | yes |  |
| `created_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/package-indexes/{name}`

Show a package index

Needs `MANAGE_PACKAGE_INDEX` on the instance, or `READ_ENVIRONMENT` on any environment. Answers 404 when no index has that name.

| `name` | path | yes | text | The package index's registered name. |

## `PATCH /api/v1/package-indexes/{name}`

Change a package index

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Changes its URL or credential secret. Needs `MANAGE_PACKAGE_INDEX` on the instance. Answers 404 when no index has that name, 409 when the new URL belongs to another index, and 422 when nothing is given or a field cannot be changed.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | The package index's registered name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `PackageIndexUpdate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text or null | no |  |
| `credential_secret` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |

| `200` | Successful Response | `PackageIndexOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |

## `DELETE /api/v1/package-indexes/{name}`

Delete a package index

Projects whose lock file names the index fail their next execution until it is registered again. Needs `MANAGE_PACKAGE_INDEX` on the instance. Answers 404 when no index has that name.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | The package index's registered name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |
